g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots with3.1mm guard; logical joins de-duplicated. Jug clear aperture retained. Truss support-top explicitly snaps2mm upward to lower-chord logical row. Optional near-junction samples omitted, not Braille or actual tactile validation.

use.data-design-purpose: Differentiate material from air: lower grey object surface, unchanged higher outline/features, and white unraised openings. Openings are not shaded as solid material.
Keep the actual opening unraised within the shaded material; existing border and internal features stay above it.
